connector.name: Mu
connector.registryDescription: Official AI-native print-on-demand MCP - say it, AI designs it, sell 40+ goods, earn royalties.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.wearmu.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.wearmu, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api_key>. Optional at first: call mu_register + mu_verify with no auth to get an api_key, then reconnect with it.
